title: SetPrint: Black-Box LLM Fingerprinting via Setwise Correspondence of Response Changes
abstract: arXiv:2611.12950v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Black-box LLM fingerprinting aims to determine whether a target model was derived from a source model when only the output responses to input queries are observable. One way to reveal this relationship is to perturb each query and observe the resulting responses of both models, yielding two corresponding sets of response variations. These sets provide two complementary sources of information: the relations among response changes within each set, and the correspondence of response changes between the two sets. Existing approaches, however, have not fully exploited both. We introduce \textbf{SetPrint}, a training-free method that jointly captures both within-set relations and between-set correspondence. SetPrint expresses each response change relative to the mean change of its own set, and then compares changes from the two models that were induced by the same perturbation. translated_title: SetPrint：基于响应变化集合对应关系的黑盒大语言模型指纹识别
translated_abstract: 黑盒大语言模型指纹识别旨在仅在可观察模型对输入查询的输出响应的情况下，判断目标模型是否源自某个源模型。揭示这种关系的一种方式是对每个查询施加扰动，并观察两个模型由此产生的响应，从而得到两组相应的响应变化集合。这些集合提供了两种互补的信息来源：每组内部响应变化之间的关系，以及两组之间响应变化的对应关系。然而，现有方法并未充分同时利用这两者。我们提出了SetPrint，这是一种无需训练的方法，能够同时捕捉集合内部关系和集合间对应关系。SetPrint将每个响应变化表示为相对于其所在集合平均变化的偏差，然后比较两个模型由同一扰动所引起的变化。在LeaFBench上，SetPrint持续优于现有的训练（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: SetPrint提出了一种无需训练的黑盒LLM指纹识别方法，首次同时利用集合内部响应变化关系和两个模型对相同扰动的响应变化对应关系，来判定目标模型是否源自源模型。
en_tdlr: SetPrint is a training-free black-box LLM fingerprinting method that jointly exploits within-set relations of response changes and their between-set correspondence induced by the same perturbations to determine whether a target model derives from a source model.
